title: draft board
def: past drafts: the board in draft week. FV = draft-day grade (scripts/cbb_draftday.py: season just played + the June boards; college exits 2009-16 graded by fits that held out his class, later exits by the fit on 2009-16), Cons = consensus of the ESPN and NBADraft.net final boards, Pick = actual NBA pick, Out = the career on the FV scale (drafts through 2020).
views: what he became: NBA career on the FV scale

cols.t: predictive mock pick (consensus + model, Tankathon order)
consensus rank: median on 10 2027 boards; past drafts, ESPN and NBADraft.net final boards
80% range of his pick across 2,000 simulated drafts
chance he enters the 2027 draft (declare model)
what he became: NBA career on the FV scale (drafts through 2020, six NBA seasons or more)
